notes: Exploratory pilot (SIS-FEAT-15): A vs E with Claude Code, Docker split custody, 900 s / 150k tokens / 100 tool calls per arm. Fill every <placeholder>. Holdout repositories and tasks are added by tools/import_study_tasks.py --partition holdout --merge-into <this file>; induction repositories are the ones the guidance bundle was learned and qualified on (their entries must match the learning spec's paths). Build with tools/build_efficacy_manifest.py, then commit the manifest before the first run. See docs/v3/PILOT_RUNBOOK.md.

protocol.notes: Pilot: estimates the A-to-E effect, its interval, the intra-repository correlation, cost per task and the negative-transfer rate, and sizes a confirmatory study with sis.v3.governed_eval.required_repositories. An exploratory manifest can never yield a confirmatory label.
